intro: Venox is for gamers who command every edge. With its futuristic silhouette, magnetic adjustments, and performance-grade build, it delivers unmatched support, control, and dominance in every session.

features.title: Distinctive silhouette
features.text: Venox high-back chair features a sharp, angular design with precision-cut lines that stand apart. Its commanding form reflects power and focus, turning your gaming setup into a statement zone.

features.title: Magnetic lumbar system
features.text: Magnetically attached lumbar cushion adjusts effortlessly to your preferred position. This innovative system provides targeted lower-back alignment without visible straps or mechanical bulk.

features.title: Controlled back tilt for adaptive comfort
features.text: Venox supports recline with a central tilt mechanism. With a reclining angle of up to 20 degrees, it adapts to gaming intensity or relaxed breaks.

features.title: Ergonomic bucket seat design
features.text: The seat and back are sculpted in a bucket configuration that creates an engulfing, secure feel. This design enhances posture stability while delivering immersive, cocoon-like comfort during long sessions.

features.title: Seat height and depth adjustment
features.text: Venox allows seat height adjustment from approximately 435 mm to 569 mm, along with seat depth adjustment up to 60 mm. This ensures proper leg support and ergonomic alignment across different body types.

features.title: 3D armrests for precision control
features.text: Three-dimensional armrests adjust vertically, forward, backwards, and side-to-side. This flexibility supports optimal wrist and elbow positioning during gaming, typing, or streaming sessions.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
